notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Makes the Pursuit level much more forgiving.
[*] Improves collisions on several types of platforms.
[*] Improves visuals for the ending.
[*] Adds several missing translations.
[*] Reworks options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent certain levels from ending properly (such as Sacrifice).
[*] General bug fixes.
[*] Adds a loading spinner.
[*] Removed cheese...
[/list]

notes.title: Dyadic is in French!
notes.content:
Today we have launched French for our game! This is a big step for us since while developing we had no intention of translating the game. It was thanks to an awesome user who approached us and offered to translate the game that made us want to do it.

At the moment, we have only released French. However, if you are interested in helping out translate the game for other languages, shoot us a message and we will be sure to reply shortly. 

We also fixed a few bugs this patch including one that was making it impossible to pass 1-6. We sincerely apologise for that issue, and we made sure to fix it quickly. 

On another note, the Level Editor for Dyadic is coming along and will be our next major patch. Half the team is still working on that while we are touching up an old project we made during a 48hour Game Jam. 

It's an exciting time for Handsome Dragon Games, and we love hearing feedback and suggestions for all the community. If you ever want to get in touch, we will always be happy to reply.

Thanks for taking the time to read!

- Handsome Dragon Games Team

Our support email for things such as bugs and issues support@handsomedragongames.com
